correctness.rationale: For k,m>=2 identify Boolean semilattice of idempotents; compatibility of rank-one block arrows forces the induced atom permutation to be identity or simultaneous reversal. Composition of rank-one arrows forms a connected Brandt groupoid and forces labels F_ij(g)=a_j phi(g) a_i^-1 with one phi in Aut(S_m), a_1=1; all higher-rank arrows are their unique natural-order join. Conversely the formulas preserve composability and multiplication. Hence |Aut(M_km)|=2(m!)^(k-1)|Aut(S_m)| and spatial iff phi inner; exceptional Out(S_6)=C2 gives precisely half nonspatial when m=6. Independent exact construction checked all 676 multiplication equations for (k,m)=(2,2) and 31752 for (3,2), with 4 and 8 distinct automorphisms, respectively. Finite checks do not establish all k,m or outer S6: intrinsic groupoid proof and cited S6 classification do.
